purpose: Produce the missing causal physical-force-to-Ni-displacement filter on the approved moving active-model baseline; do not substitute initial H37 force variance for Ni coherence.
existing_solutions: Original immutable coefficient archives and saved finite-result snapshot
filter_interface: build_canonical_force_filter(correlations, q, final_time, coordinates) -> compact filter with evaluate(time) returning ionic_force[ndof,nprobes], field_force[nfield,nprobes], initial_dual[state_size,nprobes], segment arrays and metadata
baseline_interface: prepare_saved_active_baseline(original_result_path, *, work_directory) -> object with coefficients, baseline, correlations, coordinate, source, work; no unfinished-filter import
numerics: Reuse admitted nonconjugating L(t).T and the original DOP853 rtol/atol. Physical force enters p-prime with plus sign; global field-momentum force enters Pi-prime. No extra mass, spin, source weight or cell multiplier in the filter. Keep the full initial dual for later original-preparation cross terms. Store only canonical forcing components of the DOP853 dense polynomial, not a state-sized history or transition bank. Degree-seven small-component Chebyshev representation may be constructed from the existing public dense evaluator and accepted integration intervals, with owning independent forced-ODE/SymPy checks; do not add a new adaptive approximation or tolerance gate.
execution: Parent executes only after both complete code slices settle. One necessary new loaded maximum-model Gamma baseline reconstruction and filter pilot, CPU7/BLAS1, Native MemoryMax4GiB/swap0/RuntimeMax600s. No finite-dose trajectory or all16 replay. Record reconstructed history as NEW, not recovered original adaptive state.
storage: One reported shared5GiB pool. Original data immutable. New small filter output and necessary Gamma-only working view; no all-q/full-state/full-action bank.
scientific_scope: Conditional active-model causal filter, not full-PW moving mean, complete passive two-time noise, physical loss, a coherence correction or a lifetime. Full passive influence still requires its actual ordered kernel/response and retained/omitted cross terms.
